Name: Hebe's Maru
Author: Hebebait
Description:
Changes Maru to look like a cuter and much frizzier-haired teen version of herself, inspired by how she appeared in the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29]early development build[/url] of Stardew Valley.
I really disliked the original turtleneck collar, so I edited her top to be similar to the way Maru's actual vanilla design looks with more skin showing from her neck down. I also removed the yellow buttons on her sprite to match the portrait.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/smYO0EK.png[/img]

Includes just the replacement files for Maru's portrait & sprite.
Contrary to the modded joke screenshot above, this contains no dialogue change or added events[url=https://allthefallen.ninja/index.php?/topic/5396-lewd-loli-maru-mod/].[/url]
